BM Operations Module – Assessment Questions
Oct 27, 2026 · @Gleuhr
How to use this paper
The trainee BM answers 57 objective (multiple-choice) questions, covering every point of the Operations module in order, including its 7 practical tasks (Section 9). Every answer follows the BM Process Guidelines v3 and Training Module v4, with the BM shift running 9:30 AM to 7:00 PM.
Trainee name
Branch
Date
Score (out of 57)
Ops trainer





Questions: circle one answer per question. Suggested pass mark: 46 out of 57 (80%), to be confirmed by the Ops trainer.
Practical sign-off: the trainer also watches the 7 practical tasks being done and signs the table in the last section.
Answer key: the last section is for trainers only. Remove it before printing the trainee copy.
Section 1: Shift timeline and daily rhythm
Q1. What are the Branch Manager's working hours?
a) 8:00 AM to 8:30 PM
b) 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM
c) 9:30 AM to 7:00 PM
d) 10:00 AM to 7:30 PM
Q2. The clinic opens at 9:30 AM. By what time must the opening photo and confirmation be shared?
a) 9:45 AM
b) 9:30 AM
c) 10:05 AM
d) 11:00 AM
Q3. How long should each part of the morning briefing run?
a) Reception 10 min, housekeeping 10 min, counsellors 10 min
b) Reception 5 min, housekeeping 5 min, counsellors 10 min
c) One 30-minute meeting for all staff together
d) Reception 5 min, housekeeping 10 min, counsellors 5 min
Q4. After the 9:30 AM opening photos, when are the photo rounds of every area posted?
a) Every hour from 10:00 AM
b) Only at opening and at closing
c) 11:00, 1:00, 3:00 and 5:00
d) 11:30, 1:30, 3:30 and 5:30
Q5. Which of these is part of the branch hygiene standard?
a) Medical stock may stay open on trolleys during the day
b) Washroom checklist photo at day-end and a weekly deep-cleaning schedule
c) Deep cleaning once a month is enough
d) Washroom photos only when a client complains
Q6. When is the BM-Doctor meeting held, and what happens to its Minutes of Meeting (MoM)?
a) 6:00 PM; discussed verbally, no MoM needed
b) Once a week; MoM filed at month-end
c) 10:05 to 10:25 AM; MoM filed the same day to the RH, Manisha and Dr Kanikta
d) 9:30 AM; MoM filed the next morning
Q7. A client pays at 6:50 PM, after the BM's 6:30 PM cash cut-off. What is the correct handover?
a) The FDM reconciles it, seals it with a signed slip, does the closing audit with housekeeping and sends the debrief by 8 PM; the BM checks the slip at 9:30 AM next day
b) The BM must stay until the last client leaves
c) The payment is left unrecorded until the next morning
d) Reception keeps the cash in the drawer and tells the BM on WhatsApp
Section 2: Stock and inventory
Q8. How often is the branch stock sheet updated and the physical stock counted?
a) Stock sheet weekly; physical count monthly
b) Only when the RH visits the branch
c) Stock sheet daily; physical count once a month
d) Stock sheet daily, plus a morning physical count that must match the recorded stock
Q9. You receive 3 boxes of an injectable, each holding 10 vials. What do you record?
a) 30 vials, with the expiry date
b) 3 boxes
c) 3, with no unit
d) Whichever unit is quicker that day
Q10. The morning count shows 4 units fewer than the stock sheet. What do you do?
a) Change the sheet so it matches the count
b) Wait for the next physical audit to sort it out
c) Report the mismatch immediately to the RH and the Operations Team
d) Borrow 4 units from a nearby branch to cover the gap
Q11. Another branch asks you to send 5 units urgently. What is the rule?
a) Send them and adjust Zoho later
b) Transfer only with the required management approval and documentation; no Zoho change without authorisation
c) Send them if the RH agrees on a phone call
d) Never send stock to another branch under any condition
Q12. A stock delivery arrives at the branch. What must happen before it is accepted?
a) Sign the delivery note and count it later in the week
b) Let reception receive it without checking
c) Accept it if the box is sealed
d) Verify the stock received against the delivery documents and acceptance controls
Q13. During the physical stock audit, which approach is correct?
a) Count every item, record quantities and expiry dates, list every discrepancy, and send the report to Operations by the deadline
b) Adjust figures so the audit shows zero variance
c) Count only fast-moving items
d) Tell the RH the result verbally
Q14. What is the monthly stock-intent schedule?
a) Requests can be raised on any day
b) Requests on the 1st–2nd and the 15th–16th
c) Reminders on the 1st and 15th; requests in the 3rd–5th and 16th–18th windows
d) Requests on the 10th and the 22nd
Q15. When is a stock request approved, and when should it be fulfilled?
a) Approved when entered in the Google Sheet; fulfilled within 24 hours
b) Approved only when the RH approves; fulfilled by the 10th and 22nd, allowing 4–5 days for logistics
c) Approved by the concerned ME; fulfilled at month-end
d) Approved automatically after 3 days; fulfilled on the 15th
Section 3: Reporting, issues and escalation
Q16. Which statement about the BM's daily reports is correct?
a) The BM Daily Log, BM EOD report and stock report are separate, and all three are submitted by 7:00 PM
b) The EOD report covers stock, so a separate stock report is not needed
c) Reports can be submitted any time before midnight
d) The stock report is weekly; the EOD report is daily
Q17. What does the BM send between 6:55 and 7:00 PM?
a) Only the EOD report
b) A voice note to the RH
c) A summary of every client seen that day
d) A 5-line WhatsApp summary to the RH (numbers, one story, one worry, one ask) and a handover note to the FDM
Q18. What must every Issue Tracker entry contain?
a) Only the problem description
b) The problem, branch, responsible owner, required action, target date and current status
c) The problem and a photo; the RH adds the rest
d) The name of the staff member at fault
Q19. Which issues must be escalated without delay?
a) A late delivery of napkins
b) A staff member asking for leave next month
c) Machine breakdowns, security incidents, infrastructure failures and patient-safety concerns
d) A client asking for a discount
Q20. The technician tells you on the phone that the machine is repaired. When do you close the issue?
a) Straight away, because the technician confirmed it
b) After 7 days if no one complains
c) When the RH asks about it
d) Only after the machine has been checked at the branch and closure evidence is shared; follow up until then
Q21. What does the BM owe the RH on coordination and audits?
a) Visibility of stock, issues, breakdowns, complaints and audit points; corrective actions done, with trackers updated and evidence
b) A monthly phone call only
c) Audit findings only when the RH visits the branch
d) Nothing beyond the EOD report
Q22. You forgot to enter yesterday's figure. What do you do?
a) Enter it with yesterday's date so no one notices
b) Leave it out; one missing entry does not matter
c) No backdated entries: enter it today with the correct details and tell the RH about the gap
d) Ask reception to enter it under their name
Section 4: Petty cash
Q23. What is the weekly petty-cash allocation per branch?
a) ₹2,000
b) ₹4,000
c) ₹5,000
d) ₹10,000
Q24. An urgent repair will cost ₹1,800. What is the correct approach?
a) Pay it and inform the RH at the end of the week
b) Split it into four bills under ₹500 each
c) Ask the vendor to send the bill to HO directly, with no approval
d) Get prior RH approval; Deepa processes the payment; never split the bill
Q25. When can the BM ask for petty cash to be topped up before the weekly cycle?
a) When the balance falls below ₹1,000
b) Whenever any amount has been spent
c) Only at month-end
d) Never; the weekly amount is fixed
Q26. How must each petty-cash expense be recorded?
a) In a personal notebook, shared at month-end
b) On WhatsApp to the RH
c) In Airtable, with the bill, voucher or screenshot attached, and the name, contact, amount, purpose and signature
d) Only expenses above ₹500 need to be recorded
Q27. What is the weekly petty-cash cycle?
a) Submit Monday, reconcile Wednesday, paid Saturday
b) Submit Tuesday evening, reconcile Thursday, paid by Friday
c) Submit and get paid on the same day
d) Submit Friday, paid the following Tuesday
Section 5: Day-end reconciliation
Q28. When does the BM reconcile Cash, Card and UPI, and for which billing?
a) At 9:30 AM the next day, for the previous full day
b) Once a week, on Thursday
c) 6:30 to 6:45 PM, for all billing up to the 6:30 PM cut-off
d) At 7:00 PM, for billing up to closing time
Q29. How is the day's cash counted and checked?
a) Denomination by denomination (₹500, ₹200, ₹100, ₹50, ₹20, ₹10 with quantities), with every variance explained
b) Only the total is counted
c) Variances under ₹100 can be ignored
d) Reception counts it; the BM does not check it
Q30. Which evidence supports the day-end reconciliation?
a) A WhatsApp message saying "cash tallied"
b) Only the CRM sales report
c) Nothing, if the totals match
d) A photo of the sealed cash envelope (amount, date, sign-off), the card machine day-end slip, and the reconciliation summary photo
Q31. A bill is raised at 6:50 PM. How is it handled and checked?
a) It is added to the next day's sales without any slip
b) The FDM reconciles it and seals it with a signed slip; the BM checks the slip at 9:30 AM next morning
c) The BM comes back to the branch to count it
d) It is not recorded until the client's next visit
Section 6: Patient records, CRM and payments
Q32. A booked client does not turn up. What is entered in Airtable, and when?
a) Nothing; only visits are entered
b) "Cancelled", at the end of the week
c) "Rescheduled", the next day
d) "No Show", on the same day
Q33. Which fields must be correct on every Airtable entry?
a) Customer type, clinic name, payment mode and amount
b) Only the amount
c) Only the client name
d) Payment mode only, for card payments
Q34. An old client has been registered again as a new entry. What process applies?
a) Keep both entries
b) Delete the old entry
c) Follow the clinic-card photo verification process
d) Ask the client which entry she prefers
Q35. A client pays a token amount and wants a customised plan. How is it handled?
a) Note it on paper and enter it later
b) Follow the prescribed CRM process for token payments, customised plans and package conversion
c) Take the payment outside the system until the plan is final
d) Enter it as a normal session
Q36. A complimentary product is given to a client. How is it recorded?
a) It is not recorded because it is free
b) It is written in the client's file only
c) It is billed at full price and refunded
d) It is billed and recorded as instructed, including the ₹1 billing rule where it applies
Q37. Where are courier or pickup details and prescriptions entered?
a) Courier or pickup details in the CRM / Airtable workflow; prescriptions in the mandatory prescription portal
b) Both on WhatsApp to the client
c) Both on paper in the client file
d) Prescriptions in Airtable; courier details by phone
Q38. A client asks for the Easy No-Cost EMI through G-Money. What must the BM or counsellor do?
a) Promise approval so she books today
b) Tell her EMI is not available
c) Explain tenure, terms and charges, apply on the portal with accurate details, and never promise approval until G-Money confirms
d) Take the full payment and apply for EMI later
Q39. A client complains about her results. How is it handled?
a) Note it in the EOD report only
b) Track the complaint to closure, update follow-ups and next appointments, and email Dr Kanikta (treatment results) with Dr Navreet and the RH copied
c) Ask the counsellor to handle it alone
d) Wait for the client to call again
Section 7: Machines, infrastructure and security
Q40. What does the machine tracker record?
a) Only machines that are currently broken
b) The machine name and the technician's phone number
c) One entry per machine: make or company, serial number from the back (or NA), and repair status
d) Only machines under warranty
Q41. A machine stops working mid-session. What is the first step?
a) Report the fault promptly and troubleshoot with the technician before arranging an external repair
b) Send it to Delhi straight away
c) Keep using it at a lower setting
d) Wait for the RH's next visit
Q42. The branch inverter has failed. What do you do?
a) Ask housekeeping to call any local electrician
b) Mention it in next week's report
c) Wait until the power goes off to check
d) Log it in the Issue Tracker and email it to Saurabh (operations and maintenance) with the RH copied
Q43. You open the CCTV app to check a camera. What must you do afterwards?
a) Close the app; nothing else is needed
b) Verify that recording is still active on every camera
c) Restart the recorder
d) Switch off the cameras you did not need
Q44. A theft or safety incident happens at the branch. Which response is correct?
a) Handle it quietly within the branch
b) Mention it in the monthly report
c) Escalate immediately, document the incident, and follow up the corrective actions
d) Ask the staff to sort it out among themselves
Section 8: Staff management
Q45. A receptionist arrives at 10:10 AM. What does the BM do?
a) Ignore it if it is the first time
b) Mark attendance correctly and report the late arrival with the reason
c) Mark her present from 9:30
d) Send her home for the day
Q46. A staff member arrives in a round-neck T-shirt with no badge. What is the rule?
a) Allowed on weekends
b) Allowed if she is not at the front desk
c) Allowed if the T-shirt is plain
d) Not permitted: formal attire and badge are required; correct it privately
Q47. What must the weekly roster include, and when is it shared?
a) Next week's roster, including Sunday cover, shared in advance
b) This week's roster, shared on Monday morning
c) Weekdays only; Sundays are arranged on the day
d) Only the doctor's schedule
Q48. How are daily duties assigned and confirmed?
a) Verbally, with no record
b) Duties are fixed and never change
c) Assigned at the morning briefing and confirmed in the designated WhatsApp group
d) Posted on the notice board once a month
Q49. Two therapists are absent and no replacement is available. What do you do?
a) Email HR (Mizraem) with the RH copied, and coordinate a replacement
b) Cancel every appointment without telling anyone
c) Ask the counsellor to do the treatments
d) Wait until the next day to report it
Q50. A new process goes live next week. What must the BM confirm first?
a) Nothing; staff will learn on the job
b) That the RH has read the process
c) That the process has been posted on WhatsApp
d) That the team understands the step-by-step workflow, has its credentials and can access the system
Section 9: Practical tasks
Q51. What does shadowing one full BM shift involve?
a) Watching the clinic opening only
b) Working alongside the trainer for the full 9:30 AM to 7:00 PM shift and filling a practice BM Daily Log
c) Reading the process guidelines at home
d) Spending the morning half of the shift with the FDM
Q52. You run the opening alone. Which sequence is correct?
a) Huddles at 9:00, open at 9:30, opening photo at 10:00
b) BM-Doctor meeting first, then open the clinic, then the briefings
c) Open at 9:30 and check every room → opening photo and confirmation by 9:45 → briefings 9:45 to 10:05 → duties confirmed on WhatsApp
d) Open at 9:30 and post the first photos at the 11:30 round
Q53. You complete the stock sheet and physical count alone, and 2 bottles are missing. What does a correct submission show?
a) The sheet changed to match the count
b) The count in boxes, with the 2 bottles left out
c) Nothing until the next audit
d) The count in units with expiry dates, the sheet unchanged, and the 2-bottle mismatch reported to the RH and Operations
Q54. It is 6:58 PM. Which shows your reports submitted on time?
a) BM Daily Log, BM EOD report and stock report each submitted separately before 7:00 PM
b) BM EOD report sent; stock report to follow the next morning
c) One combined report covering EOD and stock
d) Stock report sent by 9:00 PM from home
Q55. At the 6:30 PM cut-off the system shows cash of ₹12,400, but you count ₹12,100. What do you do?
a) Change the system figure to ₹12,100
b) Record both figures, explain the ₹300 variance, attach the sealed-envelope photo and card slip, and have the trainer check it
c) Add ₹300 from petty cash so it tallies
d) Ignore it because it is under ₹500
Q56. Which Issue Tracker entry is complete and correctly closed?
a) "AC not working"
b) "AC issue – told RH on WhatsApp"
c) "Closed – technician called"
d) "AC not cooling in Cabin 2 – owner: BM – target date set – emailed Saurabh with RH copied – closed after the technician's visit, with a photo of it working"
Q57. When does the Ops trainer give the final sign-off?
a) Once the trainee has attended all training days
b) When the trainee asks for it
c) When the trainee scores 46 out of 57 or more and every practical task has been observed and signed
d) After the trainee shadows one shift
